status_note: DS2 reserved, not scored: DS2 is unconsumed. The pin is pending: it is valid only for a head that is frozen and scored once, and a different head needs a new pin. Until then the test split stays untouched and unscored (held by the Orchestrator and agreed by the Evaluator, 2026-10-14, because this head misses the minimums on development data and DS2 can be scored once).
purpose: DS2 reserved, not scored. If the test split is ever scored, this file freezes the PVC method, its thresholds and model, the records, the definitions, the code and the minimums, chosen on the development records only, BEFORE the test split is touched (M3 exit gate part 2, item 1). From the scoring on, the test split is consumed: it is scored once, in its own PR, with this file as input; no decision about the method may be informed by it.

test_split.name: inter-patient test split of MIT-BIH Arrhythmia (DS2), same database as the development split

excluded.202: same subject and tape as 201, which is a development record

signal.windows: consecutive non-overlapping 10 s (2,500 samples) from sample 0; a trailing partial window is not scored; windows are independent
signal.beats_in_scope: annotated beats inside whole windows, symbols N L R B A a J S V r F e j n E / f Q ?

detector.chosen_on: development records only: most V beats found with beat-level PPV >= 0.99

definitions.negatives: every other beat symbol, F (fusion) and E (escape) included, and they stay in the denominators; false positives are reported by reference symbol
definitions.match: one-to-one, within 150 ms, detections and annotated beats both sorted, two-pointer
definitions.sensitivity: true positives / annotated V beats in scope; a V beat the detector missed, or detected but not callable, or detected and not called, is a false negative
definitions.ppv: true positives / every detection called PVC, matched to an annotated beat or not
definitions.specificity: 1 - (annotated non-V beats matched to a detection called PVC) / (annotated non-V beats); a beat the detector missed is not called PVC
definitions.pooling: pooled (micro) counts over records; records with no PVCs are listed and stay in the denominators
definitions.callable: a beat is callable when 60 samples either side of its R peak lie inside its own 10 s window; a beat that is not callable is never called
definitions.window_placement: V beats with no detection on the evaluated grid but one on the same detector run on a grid shifted by half a window (5 s), reported as a separate count next to sensitivity; they remain false negatives

primary.name: RR-ratio rule
primary.rule: interval before the beat / the window's median interval < theta
primary.median_needs: at least 4 detections in the window
primary.chosen_on: development records only, pooled beat-level F1 over theta 0.50 to 0.95

secondary.name: RR-ratio rule with a compensatory pause
secondary.rule: interval before / median < theta and interval after / median > phi
secondary.chosen_on: development records only, pooled beat-level F1 over theta 0.50 to 0.95 and phi 1.00 to 1.40
secondary.reported: with its own paired difference and interval; the better of the two is never picked after scoring

head.kind: 60 boosted trees (depth 3) over 12 beat-relative features, numpy forward pass
head.threshold_rule: first maximum of pooled out-of-fold beat-level F1 over 0.05 to 0.95 step 0.05
head.selection: record-grouped five-fold cross-validation on the development records: no beat-level random split, no record in two folds, early stopping off, hyperparameters fixed before any fold was fitted

minimums.basis: pooled (micro) point estimates on the test split; set by the Evaluator before the annotation counts were known (they did not know them); the user may overrule
minimums.intervals: record-level percentile 95%, reported and quoted in the claim, not gating
minimums.comparator: pass or fail does not depend on beating the comparator; the card says plainly if the learned head adds nothing

statistics.paired: head minus primary comparator, and head minus secondary comparator, each with its own interval, on the same beats

disclosure: The annotation counts of the 22 DS2 records (3,220 V in 16 of 22 records, 202 included) were read once on 2026-10-14 to establish that a PVC metric was feasible, and were reported to the Orchestrator and the Evaluator in the Researcher's plan. No DS2 signal, detector output or method result had been computed on DS2 when this pin was written.

claims.allowed: None for PVC detection while DS2 is not scored. If the test split is scored: retrospective, public data; inter-patient test split of MIT-BIH Arrhythmia (DS2), same database as the development split; 21 records
limitations_to_state: PVC across devices and sites untested

consumption: Applies only if the test split is scored: scored once, by one scripted command, output committed with its sha256; a rerun is only a reproduction check with identical output; nothing is tuned after the first test-split number, and a mismatch is reported, not fixed. Not applicable while DS2 is reserved and not scored.
